get.description: Loads and renders the footer content layout with full element trees. Uses domain-aware resolution to find the appropriate footer assignment for the current sales channel and domain. Field selection is not supported: a request carrying an `includes` or `excludes` parameter is rejected with HTTP 400.

parameters.name: sw-language-id
parameters.description: Instructs Shopware to return the response in the given language.

200.description: Footer layout metadata with fully hydrated element trees.

get.summary: Fetch rendered footer content layout (decomposed format)
get.description: Loads and renders the footer content with decomposed format: skeletons + deduplicated data + assignments. Uses domain-aware resolution. Optimized for bandwidth efficiency. Field selection is not supported: a request carrying an `includes` or `excludes` parameter is rejected with HTTP 400.

parameters.name: sw-language-id
parameters.description: Instructs Shopware to return the response in the given language.

200.description: Footer layout metadata with element skeletons, deduplicated property data, and element-to-data mappings.

get.summary: Fetch footer content layout skeleton (without hydration)
get.description: Returns footer layout structure without hydrated data. Uses domain-aware resolution. Useful for layout preview, client-side hydration, or structure inspection. Field selection is not supported: a request carrying an `includes` or `excludes` parameter is rejected with HTTP 400.

parameters.name: sw-language-id
parameters.description: Instructs Shopware to return the response in the given language.

200.description: Footer layout metadata with element trees before hydration.

get.summary: Fetch footer content data only (without skeleton)
get.description: Returns only the hydrated data and element-to-property assignments for the footer. Uses domain-aware resolution. Useful when client already has the skeleton and only needs refreshed data. Field selection is not supported: a request carrying an `includes` or `excludes` parameter is rejected with HTTP 400.

parameters.name: sw-language-id
parameters.description: Instructs Shopware to return the response in the given language.

200.description: Footer layout metadata with deduplicated property data and element-to-data mappings.
